lens: Geometry and proportion first (17 in seat width / 34 in pitch as scale), then materials and colour judged on 1:1 physical-scale photo/render crops, then lighting on the seats (noted, scored separately), then artefacts. Renders: /tmp/claude-0/r11 (q15-q18 and studio e1-e9) and extra studio shots /tmp/claude-0/raterB11/st/x1_pantop, x2_front (head-on like y_47300), x3_quarter, x4_cover (head-on like y_47306), x5_coverside. Comparison sheets: /tmp/claude-0/raterB11/fab_sheet.png (700 px/m: photo vs render, 4 fabrics), tiles.png (1200 px/m: tile vs photo), fleck_mos.png (sans 14 vs render at 1500 px/m), q16cmp.png, p00z.png (y_47300 2x), p03z.png (y_47303 2x). Script /tmp/claude-0/raterB11/meas.py (same method as w10b).
lightingNote: The economy darkening regression (w10b-1) is gone at head: q15 fabric L50 54-79 (r10 27-37; y_47300 46-93), q17 row-2 shell L170 #a7abb1 (r10 103; y_47303 170), q18 shell L175 (r10 114; y_47305 192). In q16 the fabric is less saturated than in y_47301 (mid back #4b588b B/R 1.86 against #3e5397 B/R 2.4), but in q15 B/R matches (1.86-2.19 against 1.88-2.32), so this is light hue / falloff along the cabin, not material. Not scored here.

priorIssues.issue: w10b-1 / w10a-5 (high/medium, lighting): the whole econ block was darkened
w10a-1 / w10b-8 (medium/low): the tick weave had no column structure
priorIssues.evidence: Column contrast on q15 seat 3 (high-passed column means): colCV 0.064 -> 0.089, col/row 1.22 -> 2.43. Photos: y_47300 s1 3.37, s3 5.16; y_47306 M 1.76. The render now sits inside the photo range, and the columns read in q15. Up close (tiles.png), the tile is sparse crisp 2 mm rectangles on a near-black ground. y_47306 M is a dense field of slanted 1-2 mm strokes (light fraction 0.29-0.5), so close-ups still read as digital rain (see new issue w11b-3).

priorIssues.issue: w10a-2 / w10b-2 (medium): the diamonds were isolated crisp decals
priorIssues.evidence: The diamonds are now a chained lattice touching tip to tip (e4b, q15 s1, x3). Figure size in fab_sheet is ~6 cm against 7-8.5 cm in y_47306 L. The fill is still horizontal scanline hatching (tiles.png, e4b); the photo has a soft, mottled, feathered fill. Contrast is too low and the colour too dark: render light/dark #586492/#2f3862 (e4b), #566291/#2f3865 (q15), against y_47306 L #a6bbe8/#465da1 and y_47302 M #6e7eae/#343e6d.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-3 (medium): head-on, the covers were 1.6-2.9x as bright as the backs
priorIssues.evidence: q15 cover/back r10 1.77/2.81/2.87/2.17 -> r11 1.12/1.34/1.45/1.39. y_47300 gives 0.68/0.90/0.54/0.76. The middle-seat covers are #60688b-#61698c against photo #1e253d-#282d49. Some of the drop came from the backs getting brighter, not from the cover getting darker. q16 is right: 1.07-1.09 against 0.80-1.06.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-4 / w10b-4 (medium): the dash mosaic read as barcode columns
priorIssues.evidence: The vertical barcode is gone: rows of short dashes in bricks. But the photo's defining macro structure is still missing: rectangular blocks ~2.8 x 1.7-2.0 cm with visible block edges and strong block-to-block tone contrast, laid in brick rows (y_47306 R, y_47303 near back, y_47300 s4 pan, sans 14 pan). The tile cells are 16.7 x 22 mm (taller than wide) with a 40/26 % density contrast and no gap, so the blocks do not read (tiles.png, fab_sheet row 2). The tile's dashes are saturated cyan (#7fa0e0-ish) on black-navy; the photo's are greyish white on navy.

priorIssues.issue: w10b-3 (medium): the headrest cover was a rigid slab with a short drop
priorIssues.evidence: Drop below the pad bottom in x4 (head-on) is 45 px on a 215 px pad = 21 %; y_47306 middle seat 20 %, right seat 25 %. Thanks to the rolled top fold, the top edge no longer shows a lit bevel. Side-on (x5) it still reads as a flat plate, but so does y_47303 (rigid leatherette flap).

priorIssues.issue: w10a-6 (low): the fleck blobs were round and dense
priorIssues.evidence: fleck_mos.png at 1500 px/m: sans 14 petals are pointed slivers/commas ~6-10 x 2-3 mm (aspect ~3), pale grey-blue, about 2x as many as in the render, on a plain navy ground. Render (x4) petals are rounded polygons ~5-9 mm (aspect ~1.3), fewer, paler/whiter, and the vertical tick ground shows through between them. At q15 scale, the statistics match: light 0.19 against 0.15-0.17, p90/p50 1.90 against 1.91.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-7 (low): the armrests were straight boxes on a vertical post
priorIssues.evidence: e7 / x1 / x3: horizontal rounded bar on a vertical post set back from the nose. y_47303 (p03z.png) and y_47300 (p00z.png): the arm top slopes slightly down to the front, has a rounded nose with a round end cap, and its front sweeps down in one J into the white lower frame under the pan front.

priorIssues.issue: w10a-8 (low): the tray face had a 3-socket item with red marks, and the handset was small
priorIssues.evidence: q18 still shows the black 3-port box with red marks on the tray face (x 360-400, y 410), and e2 / e9 show it too. Handset/bezel width: q18 168/430 = 0.39; y_47305 300/600 = 0.50.

priorIssues.issue: w10b-5 (low): the belts were one-tone teal
priorIssues.evidence: e1 / x1 / x3: teal tongue strap with a navy buckle strap, as in y_47303 (#1d3281-#223a84).

priorIssues.issue: w10b-6 (low): the pillow outline read as a bone
priorIssues.evidence: x2 / e4b: near-rectangular, with the waist eased and the corners slightly pointed. New mismatch: a tufted centre dimple that the photo pillows do not have (w11b-4).

priorIssues.issue: w10b-7 (low): seat pans washed out under top light (studio)
priorIssues.evidence: e1 pan L50 106/130 B/R 1.43; e4b pan 159 B/R 1.31; x1 pans pale lavender. Photo pans y_47300 / 47302 / 47303: L50 63-88, B/R 1.58-1.82. In-cabin pans are not visible in any QA view (q15 shows the front-row pillows at the bottom edge), so this cannot be judged in context.

priorIssues.issue: gap10 item 1: the backs were flat slabs, so they now get crowned backs with ~4.5 cm rolls
priorIssues.evidence: x2 / x3 / e4 show soft rolled side edges and shading across the face. The backs now read as cushions inside the white shell, closer to y_47300 / 47306. Shape is unchanged in the pans (cushionSecs), which is acceptable.

priorIssues.issue: gap10 item 2: pillow crease and over-pinched outline
priorIssues.evidence: The mid-height light/dark break is gone (e4b, x2). The dimple and dome height are the remaining mismatches (w11b-4).

priorIssues.issue: gap10 item 3: derive the diamond / mosaic tiles from the photos
priorIssues.evidence: Both tiles are still synthesised (make_swatches.py y_diamond / y_mosaic), so the macro structure is still wrong: no mosaic blocks, and the diamond fill is a scanline hatch. The tick tile is now synthesised too (synth_y_tick).

priorIssues.issue: gap10 item 4: leatherette cover sheen and finer, dimmer flecks
priorIssues.evidence: The flecks are dimmer and finer at row distance, but their shape is still round (see w10a-6). The cover is still LAYER.plastic r 0.40. Head-on it is too bright (see w10a-3).

priorIssues.evidence: x4 shows the cover hem and a light stitch line at the bottom, as y_47306 does. There is still no contact darkening where the back fabric tucks into the white shell or at the centre strip edges (x2, x4).

issues.title: Dash mosaic lacks its rectangular block grid, which is the defining feature of the photo fabric
issues.evidence: y_47306 R (950 px/m), y_47303 near back (p03z.png), y_47300 seat-4 pan (p00z.png) and sans 14 pan all show brick-laid rectangular blocks ~2.6-3.0 cm wide x 1.7-2.0 cm tall. Each block is a field of 1 px horizontal greyish-white dashes. Neighbouring blocks differ strongly in density (near-solid light vs mostly navy), and a thin dark seam separates blocks within a row. tex_y_mosaic: cells 16.7 x 22 mm (portrait, the wrong aspect), density 0.40 vs 0.26 (too similar), no seams, cyan-saturated dashes on black-navy (tiles.png). In q15 s2 and x1 it reads as a uniform heather, not blocks.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): NI, NJ = 7, 11 on the 0.2 m tile (cells ~28.6 x 18.2 mm), keep the half-cell brick offset. Per-cell density drawn from {0.12, 0.30, 0.55} with rng (not a checker), so 3 tones mix irregularly. Leave a 1-px dark gap at each cell's left edge and 1 px top (no dash starts within 1 px of the cell edge). Dash colour lift (5.2, 5.4, 5.6), nearly neutral instead of bluish. Re-cut tex_y_mosaic.png and check fab_sheet row 2 against y_47306 R at 1:1.

issues.title: Head-on, the headrest covers are still brighter than the fabric; in y_47300 they are darker
issues.evidence: q15 cover/back luminance 1.12 / 1.34 / 1.45 / 1.39 against y_47300 0.68 / 0.90 / 0.54 / 0.76. Middle-seat covers #60688b against photo #1e253d-#282d49. In q16 the ratio is right (1.07-1.09 against 0.80-1.06), so the q15 excess is specular from the overhead / ceiling light on a near-vertical satin plate.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover in 09_seats.js (one shared line): c '#434a68', r 0.50, l LAYER.leather (the gap analysis asked for the leather layer; at r 0.50 the grain should no longer read as hammered metal). Alternatively, keep r 0.40 and tilt the plate a further 3-4 deg forward at the foot in 09a_econ.js l.96 (z of the 0.55 SEC from -0.1035 to -0.112), so it faces the ceiling less. Target: q15 cover/back <= 0.95 with q16 still >= 0.8.

issues.title: Diamond fabric: scanline-hatched figures, too dark and low-contrast, ~25 % too small
issues.evidence: tiles.png / fab_sheet row 1: y_47306 L figures are pale (#a6bbe8 light, #465da1 ground, light fraction 0.20, p90/p50 1.69), ~7-8.5 cm, soft-edged and mottled, stacked in vertical chains. Render e4b / q15: light #586492 on #2f3862, ~6 cm, figure interiors filled with horizontal 1-px hatch lines that read as scanlines at e4b / x4 / q16.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond(): scale the lattice so the figures are 0.075 m on the 0.26 m tile (3.5 figures per tile, not 4-5). Replace the horizontal dash fill with fill = smoothed noise (gaussian sigma ~2 mm, 40-60 % coverage) multiplied by the tick strokes, and feather the edge over 3 mm. Raise the lift to ~4.0 so the light figure reaches ~1.9x the ground. Also lift SEATMAT.yFabricB c to ~#5f6c9a (the diamond seats are the lightest fabric in y_47306 / 47302, L50 71-99).

issues.title: The pillow has a tufted button dimple and a puffy dome; the ANA pillows are flat, plain, rectangular cushions
issues.evidence: p00z.png (y_47300 2x) and sans 14: a plain pillowcase with no tuft, slightly pointed corners, a thin seam, a fairly flat face, height/width ~0.75. x2 / e4b / q15 bottom edge: a pronounced centre dimple (the darkest spot on the pillow), a domed highlight, height/width 0.64.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.119: drop the dimple factor (1 - 0.12*exp(...)) -> 1, and cut the dome 0.034 -> 0.026. In l.118, Z half-depth 0.13 -> 0.145 (h/w ~0.74).

issues.title: Fleck petals are rounded blobs on a visible tick ground; the real ones are thin slivers on plain navy
issues.evidence: fleck_mos.png (1500 px/m): sans 14 petals ~6-10 x 2-3 mm (aspect ~3), about twice as dense, pale grey-blue on plain navy. Render x4: rounded polygons 5-9 mm, aspect ~1.3, whiter, with the vertical tick ground showing between them. In q16 the near fleck backs read as snow (q16cmp.png).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck(): make the petals ellipses with aspect drawn from 2.2-3.5 (minor half-axis ~1.2 mm, major 3-5 mm) at random angles. Raise the density ~1.8x (spacing reject 6 -> 4.5 mm) and lower the lift ~10 %. Build the ground from tick at 0.4x contrast (ground = 0.94 + 0.06*t/mean), so the ticks do not read.

issues.title: Armrest is a horizontal box on a vertical post, not the sloped bar with a J front
issues.evidence: y_47303 (p03z.png): the arm top falls ~2 cm toward a rounded nose with a round end cap. Its front sweeps down in one continuous J into the white frame rail under the pan front. Render e7 / x1 / x3: level bar (SEC y 0.625-0.68), separate grey bracket and post.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.246: tilt the arm loft about its rear pivot by -4 deg (nose down). Replace the l.250 front bracket and the l.256 raked post with one swept loft from the arm nose (y 0.64, z -0.40) curving down to (y 0.42, z -0.38) in SEATMAT.arm, so it reads as a J. Add a gCyl(0.016, 0.016, 0.004) end cap disc on the nose.

issues.title: The aisle-end side panel is a solid white triangle in regular rows
issues.evidence: e3 / x3: a sculpted yShell panel fills the space between the arm and the base along its whole length. y_47303 (regular rows, near aisle seat): open frame, with the cushion side visible between the J armrest and the lower white rail. y_47302 is a bulkhead row with tray-in-arm boxes, so its panels do not transfer to rows behind. y_47301 is ambiguous (see questions).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.263: for non-bulkhead rows, shrink the block-end panel to a lower rail, e.g. SEC(0.16..0.40) only with height capped at 0.40 m, so the area under the armrest is open. Keep the full panel only where opts.bulkhead is set.

issues.title: The back-top centre strip uses the diamond fabric on non-diamond seats
issues.evidence: In q16cmp.png a diamond/star figure shows on the near fleck seat's top. y_47306 right and middle seats: the strip is a darker tick/chevron weave, not diamond.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js l.106: material F === yFabricB ? yFabric : yFabric with a darker c (e.g. {...SEATMAT.yFabric, c: '#3f4866'}), or a dedicated SEATMAT.yStrip.

issues.title: Carried over: the tray-face 3-port box with red marks, and the handset is small
issues.evidence: q18 / e2 / e9: black 3-port box with red marks centred on the tray face. sans 15 / 20 show only the placard and latch there; the AC outlet is the box by the pocket. Handset/bezel width 0.39 against 0.50 (y_47305).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: remove the tray-face port box (search for SEATMAT.port / red quads near the tray latch). Widen the handset and dock ~25 % (the dock RBox widths near l.135-140).

issues.title: No contact darkening where the fabric meets the shell and at the centre strip
issues.evidence: y_47306 shows a dark crease where the back fabric tucks into the white shell, and shadow seams beside the centre strip. x2 / x4 have clean geometric junctions.
issues.fix: In econCrownLoft(), give the ring points within 1.5 cm of the side edge a vertex-colour multiplier of ~0.8, if Builder supports per-vertex colour. Otherwise add two thin dark gQuads (#1f2540, 0.006 wide) along the back's side edges on the front face.

questionsForUser: Regular (non-bulkhead) economy rows, aisle end: open J-armrest frame as in y_47303, or a solid white side panel as the left block in y_47301 seems to show? A photo of an aisle seat in a mid-cabin row from the aisle would settle it.
Is the back-top centre strip (headrest track cover) the same fabric on every seat, or does it vary with the seat's fabric? y_47306 shows a darker tick/chevron strip on two seats.

Does the seat-back fabric switch zones within one seat? In y_47306 the right seat looks like diamond on the upper side areas and mosaic on the body. That would mean placement-woven panels, not one pattern per seat.
extraRefsSearched: No new downloads. I used the existing ref/ana/y_47300-47306 and ref/web/econ/sans_* (sans 14 for the fleck and pan mosaic at ~1000 px/m; y_47303 2x crop for the armrest, belt and mosaic blocks).
